Hi, I love your little manga, can you draw it for my oc?
my characters:
Shiratori: 183cm, very gentle but insecure man. There are always birds flying around him. Always in anxiety that Nana will leave him.
Nana: 174cm, human boy with rabbit ears and tail. Pokerface, but loves Shiratori very much.（Note that rabbit ears grow on the sides of the head, not on the hat）

Their relationship: 
Living together, having a normal daily life. Shiratori occasionally gets upset with worry, and Nana comforts him. Shiratori is always the one taking the initiative, but Nana always looks out for Shiratori. Nana doesn't show any obvious emotion, but he does have a few little gestures to show that he likes Shiratori.

my request:
Shiratori tries to sneakily touch Nana's rabbit tail, but Nana gets angry and kicks Shiratori out of the house. Please feel free to imagine the composition, movement and costume

You can cancel the request if you feel it is inappropriate or difficult.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-8sUClf7BVZXNKF5l1AitC3tV76byUh6
